Name: Demetrius is a better father
Author: ScaryMan1932
Description:
Demetrius has always felt disconnected from his step son. This has always sort of irked me somewhat because Demetrius isn't an intentionally evil guy, he is just socially inept to the point of villainy. 

I made him mention Sebastian a bit more to make him at least seem like he is trying to be a good father figure. I also made him mention Maru more :). I also added an event where he asks you for advice regarding his parenting approach. 

The event triggers after having progressed your relationship with both Demetrius AND Sebastian. There are also a couple of lines describing the after effects for both men :)

Specifics:
[spoiler] The event happens when you enter the mountain lake area between 6:10 am and 24:00 pm. You need 6 hearts with both Demetrius and Sebastian.

The player walks up on Demetrius staring into the lake. He talks about struggling to connect due to his lacking social aptitude. He then asks the player for advice. I am sad to say that in the current version, advice does not affect the outcome at all :'), but it used to in earlier versions. I thought the code would look more sleek this way I guess, but I can always re-add it later :)

After the event, the player gains a full heart of friendship with him. 

Afterwards, both him and Sebastian have lines where they discuss the things they've been up to together (music and Solarion).
[/spoiler]


This mod should no longer mess with any other mods. Thanks AirynS!

It should work now, my testing worked out but if there is a bug, I would love to know :) PM me or comment here, I am a novice when it comes to anything digital but I'm enjoying the process!

Downloads.Description: The only file you'll need. Unzip and throw in Stardew Valley/mods and you're on your way.
